Title: LSJ: Zombie flesh eater rules query

Messages.Author: Jon cooper
Messages.Body:
Leon (3pt !Gangrel Dis: ani/for) has rushed Lazverinus (10pt !Vent
with Dis: POT/FOR/pro/DOM/AUS Special: +2 hand damage)

Leon has impudently slapped down a trap, drawing out the beast,
carrion crows
and gets slapped for 4 by laz during the strike step. Leon punches laz
back for 1 and crows do 1 damage too. Leon slaps an undead persistence
down to continue the combat. Can he then taste the 2 damage he
successfully inflicted on the big man?

<for those who want to know lazverinus turned his fist into a bone
spur and vapourised the happless pig farmer the next turn :)>
Oink.

Messages.Author: LSJ
